sloka: स समाश्वस्य सहसा संक्रुद्धो राजमातुलः ।वानरान् वारयामास दण्डेन मधुमोहितान् ।। ५.६२.२९ ।।।।
transliteration: sa samāśvasya sahasā saṁkruddho rājamātulaḥ ।vānarān vārayāmāsa daṇḍena madhumohitān ।। 5.62.29 ।।।।

translations.english: At once Dadhimukha, the maternal uncle of the king became conscious and chased with a stick the intoxicated vanaras.
